steps: Corte {57} de tomate cherry em metades;
Descasque {92} de pepino, e corte em fatias redondas;
Retire as sementes de {93} de pimento, e corte em tiras finas;
Corte {94} de rabanetes em fatias;
Misture tudo numa tijela grande;
Adicione {95} de azeite e de vinagre balsâmico e misture de novo.
Adicionar a aveia a uma tijela;
Adicionar à aveia a água, de preferência aqucida. Deixe repousar durante 5min;
Adicione o leite e o adoçante, e mexa bem.
Cozer a pasta em água com sal até ficar al dente;
Numa frigideira grande, refogar o bacon em azeite com os dentes de alho esmagados durante 5min, ou até o bacon ficar tostado. Descartar os dentes de alho e mantenha a frigideira em lume baixo;
Misture a maior parte do queijo com os ovos mexidos;
Quando a pasta estiver quase cozida reserve uma gadanha da água de cozedura, e deixe a arrefecer;
Assim que a pasta esteja cozida adicionar ao bacon na frigideira usando umas pinças;
Misture a água que reservou à mistura de ovos e queijo;
Retire a frigideira do lume e despeje por cima a mistura de ovos e queijo. Envolva bem;
Polvilhe o restante queijo, a pimenta, e o manjericão, por cima da pasta, e sirva de imediato.

name: Poke Bowl (sushi rice and soy meat)

ingredients.name: Poke Bowl (sushi rice and soy meat)

steps: Sweat the mushrooms until deeply browned and moisture is gone. Don’t crowd the pan. Salt at the end. Set aside.
In the same pan, add the the olive oil. Sauté onion gently until translucent, then add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice. Stir for 1–2 minutes until slightly translucent.
Deglaze with wine. Stir until absorbed.
Ladle in hot stock, one ladle at a time, stir frequently. Maintain a gentle simmer. Add more as it absorbs. After ~15 minutes, add the cooked mushrooms back in.
Cook until al dente. Should take around 18–20 minutes in total. Add a pinch of salt near the end.
Check texture — it should be creamy, not dry or watery. Adjust with a bit more hot stock if needed.
Add the Parmesan, and do the mantecatura, for 30-60 seconds.

name: Batatas fritas com ovo e salsicha

parts.title: Broth
steps: Add garlic, and shallot to the Thermomix bowl. Chop 5 sec / Speed 5.
Scrape down the sides, then add sesame oil. Sauté 3 min / 120°C / Speed 1.
Add all other broth ingredients. Mix 5 sec / Speed 3.
Cook 15 min / 100°C / Speed 1.

parts.title: Topping & Noodles
steps: Place the Thermomix simmering basket back inside. Add two eggs.
Cook 8 min / 100°C / Speed 1 (for soft-boiled) or 10 min (for hard-boiled).
Remove eggs, place them in cold water, then peel and halve them.
Add ramen noodles directly to the Thermomix bowl. Cook 3-4 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed Soft (or per package instructions).
While cooking, julienne the carrot.
Pan-fry the Heura with a little sesame oil and soy sauce.
Divide the noodles into bowls.
Pour the hot broth over the noodles.
Top with shredded chicken, halved eggs, Heura, carrots, and nori. Enjoy.

name: Chow Mein de Heura e Cogumelos

steps: Boil the noodles for 2–3 minutes — undercook slightly, then drain and rinse with cold water. Toss in a little oil to prevent sticking.
Slice mushrooms thin so they cook quickly.
In a hot pan (wok or large skillet), add a bit of neutral oil. Sear the mushrooms until browned. Don’t crowd them — they’ll steam.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds more.
Toss in the Heura pieces. Let them brown slightly or heat through, depending on their current state.
Add your drained noodles. Stir to mix everything — don’t baby them, let them sit for a few seconds to crisp.
Add soy sauce, and chili flakes if you like heat.

name: Pasta de Heura com molho de Cogumelos

parts.title: Sauce
steps: Add onion and garlic to the Thermomix. Chop 5 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down;
Add olive oil and mushrooms. Sauté 8 min / 120°C / Speed 1;
Add salt, pepper, and cream. Cook 5 min / 90°C / Speed 2;
Blend 10 sec / Speed 6.

parts.title: Pasta and Heura
steps: Boil pasta in salted water. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Pan-fry Heura in 4 spray of olive oil until golden.
Toss pasta with sauce and Heura, combine using the reserved pasta water;
Serve while hot.
